stages.UNIT_TESTS_SELECTED: sh -c 'npm run test:changed -- $(git diff --name-only HEAD -- src tests; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard -- src tests)'

notes: UNIT_TESTS_SELECTED must pass a computed file list. `vitest related` with no arguments
selects nothing on every run while still counting as a test stage.
It must include untracked files: a brand-new test is untracked and `git diff` never lists it.
It must be permissive about an empty selection (--passWithNoTests, NOT =false): the
selection is empty on every clean tree, and CONTRIBUTING tells humans to run `ci.sh fast`.
UNIT_TESTS is the opposite — strict, because an empty full suite means there are no tests.
